contents: **Negative reasoning requires explicit completeness.** A resolution result preserves every represented alternative separately from the fact that the searched source is exhaustive. An empty incomplete result is never interpreted as proof that the name or provider does not exist. This is the resolution consequence of [Incompleteness is an explicit terminal outcome](../../../rfds/architectural-foundations/README.md#incompleteness-is-an-explicit-terminal-outcome).
